Data Tracking

Data Change Tracking System

This module provides functionality for: 1. Recording data state changes 2. Computing data fingerprints 3. Maintaining change history 4. Enabling collaborative tracking

The system ensures data modifications are tracked, logged, and shared across team members while maintaining a complete audit trail.

data_tracker.compute_data_summary(df)[source]

Generate a summary of dataframe contents.

Creates a compact representation capturing: - Row count - Column-wise numeric summaries

Parameters:

df (pd.DataFrame) – Input dataframe to summarize

Returns:

Summary statistics of the dataframe

Return type:

dict

data_tracker.distribute_state(filepath, state_data, config)[source]

Share data state information with team.

Parameters:

  • filepath (str) – Path of tracked file

  • state_data (dict) – Current state data including fingerprint and summary

  • config (dict) – System configuration

data_tracker.generate_fingerprint(summary)[source]

Generate cryptographic hash of data summary.

Uses SHA256 for: - Fixed length output - Collision resistance - Deterministic results

Parameters:

summary (dict) – Data summary to fingerprint

Returns:

Hexadecimal representation of SHA256 hash

Return type:

str

data_tracker.initialize_configuration()[source]

Initialize or load system configuration.

Creates default configuration if none exists, otherwise loads existing. Returns dict with configuration parameters.

data_tracker.load_state_history()[source]

Load the recorded history of data states.

Returns:

Mapping of file paths to their recorded states

Empty dict if no history exists

Return type:

dict

data_tracker.report_state_change(filepath, previous_state, new_summary)[source]

Generate technical report of detected changes.

Parameters:

  • filepath (str) – Path of modified file

  • previous_state (dict) – Previous recorded state

  • new_summary (dict) – Current state summary

data_tracker.update_state_history(history)[source]

Update the persistent record of data states.

Parameters:

history (dict) – Current state history to persist

The data_tracker module provides functionality for tracking and managing data states:

  • State management

  • Change detection

  • History tracking

Example Usage

from data_tracker import DataTracker

# Create a tracker instance
tracker = DataTracker()

# Track a data file
tracker.track_file('data.csv')

# Get change history
history = tracker.get_history('data.csv')
